title: Skeleton Wizard and Pink Creature
description: A skeleton wizard in a blue robe and tall hat stands on an old wooden boat with arms raised and hands open. A pink creature with big eyes and sharp teeth clings to the side of the boat while the vessel rests on a rocky outcrop in crashing waves under a swirling green and purple cosmic sky.
prompt: A skeleton wearing a blue hooded robe and tall pointed wizard hat stands on an old wooden boat covered in green moss with arms raised and hands open. A pink blob-like creature with large black eyes sharp teeth and tentacles clings to the side of the boat. The boat rests on a rocky outcrop surrounded by crashing blue waves. Behind them is a swirling green and purple cosmic portal in a dark starry sky.
